'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[2024 Israeli invasion of Lebanon]]
***[[Israel]]'s military orders the residents of 23 villages in [[Southern Lebanon|southern]] [[Lebanon]] to evacuate to areas north of the [[Awali River]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israel-orders-evacuation-more-southern-lebanese-towns-amid-rising-displacement-2024-10-12/ (Reuters)]
***The [[United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon|UNIFIL]] headquarters in [[Naqoura]], Lebanon, is hit by an Israeli airstrike. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/heavy-israeli-bombardment-in-northern-gaza-as-un-peacekeepers-in-lebanon-are-hit-again-1.7072395 (CTV News)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cwy92zjq508o (BBC News)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***A family of eight is killed in an [[Israel]]i [[airstrike]] on a home at the [[Nuseirat refugee camp]] in central [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://morningstaronline.co.uk/article/israeli-airstrike-central-gaza-wipes-out-family-eight (Morning Star)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Ukrainian conscription crisis]]
***Local media outlets report that [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian military]] recruitment officers raided shopping centers, bars, restaurants, and a large [[Music venue|concert venue]] across several [[List of cities in Ukraine|Ukrainian cities]] including [[Kyiv]], [[Dnipro]], and [[Kharkiv]] to detain men not in compliance with [[Conscription|conscription]] orders. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-war-drones-oil-depot-mobilization-40c6a27b9f98876b913a4daee0403c2c (AP)]
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**The [[National Army of Colombia]] re-enters the [[corregimiento]] of El Plateado in [[Argelia, Cauca|Argelia]], [[Cauca Department]], [[Colombia]], in an attempt to clear the corregimiento of [[FARC dissidents]]. [https://www.eltiempo.com/politica/gobierno/presidente-gustavo-petro-reacciona-a-despliegue-militar-en-el-plateado-cauca-fortin-de-las-disidencias-esto-dijo-3389715 (''El Tiempo'')]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**At least eleven people are killed and eight others are injured in tribal clashes in [[Kurram District]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-tribal-clashes-kurram-93d2722dd6403630c688404c2d1651a9 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*A speedboat explodes at a port in [[Taliabu Island Regency]], [[North Maluku]], [[Indonesia]], killing six people, including {{ill|Benny Laos|id}}, a candidate for Governor of North Maluku in the [[2024 North Maluku gubernatorial election|upcoming election]], and [[DPRD|Regional House of Representatives]] member Ester Tantri. [https://www.cnnindonesia.com/nasional/20241012173445-20-1154690/profil-cagub-malut-benny-laos-yang-tewas-dalam-ledakan-speedboat (CNN Indonesia)] [https://www.cnbcindonesia.com/news/20241012185021-4-579127/kronologi-speedboat-kampanye-meledak-tewaskan-cagub-maluku-utara (CNBC Indonesia)]
*Four people are killed and five others are injured in a [[Fuel tank|gas tank]] explosion and fire at a [[Filling station|gas station]] in [[Grozny]], [[Russia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/four-dead-after-fuel-station-blast-russias-chechnya-ministry-2024-10-12/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 United States presidential election]]
**[[Security incidents involving Donald Trump]]
***A man is arrested outside former president [[Donald Trump]]'s rally in [[Coachella, California|Coachella]], [[California]], [[United States]], with loaded firearms, a fake license plate, and several passports, in what is believed to have been an [[assassination]] attempt on Trump, according to the [[Riverside County, California|Riverside County]] sheriff. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/man-arrested-near-trump-rally-california-gun-charges-2024-10-13/ (Reuters)]
**[[Voter registration in the United States]]
***The [[United States Justice Department]] sues the state of [[Virginia]] for removing voters from [[voter registration]] less than 90 days before [[Election Day (United States)|Election Day]] on November 5. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/10/12/us-justice-department-sues-virginia-for-purging-voters-before-election (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Belarus–European Union border crisis]], [[Human rights in Poland]]
**As a response to Germany tightening border controls and following a call for EU-wide solutions by its Interior Minister [[Nancy Faeser]], [[Prime Minister of Poland]] [[Donald Tusk]] issues a request to the [[European Union]] to accept a provisional suspension of migrants' [[right to asylum]] in order to control [[Illegal immigration|irregular immigration]] from [[Belarus]], which [[Human rights defender|human rights activists]] condemn as unconstitutional. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/poland-temporarily-suspend-right-asylum-after-belarus-border-tensions-tusk-says-2024-10-12/ (Reuters)] [https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2024/10/10/poland-and-czech-republic-condemn-renewed-border-checks-within-eu (Euronews)]

'''Science and technology'''
*A 52nd [[Mersenne prime]] is discovered by a participant of the [[Great Internet Mersenne Prime Search]], six years after the last new Mersenne prime was discovered in 2018. The prime number is 41,024,320 digits in length, making it the [[largest known prime number]]. [https://www.mersenne.org/primes/?press=M136279841 (Mersenne.org)]
